responsibility: This Modula-2 definition module publishes configuration constants and helper routines from m2configure.cc to the Modula-2 side of gm2. Its main functional role is to expose the preprocessor path resolver and the fixed underscore-mangling convention flag, rather than participate directly in code generation or option parsing.
same_name_distinction: This Modula-2 definition module publishes configuration-facing items such as FullPathCPP and the fixed UseUnderscoreForC constant to Modula-2 code. Unlike m2configure.h it is the Modula-2-side interface, and unlike m2configure.cc it does not perform path synthesis.
